notes.title: Alice: Through the Fey Realm - Content Update 1.2
notes.content:
[h2]Content Update 1.2 - [b]FINAL UPDATE[/b][/h2]

This is our final update for 'Alice: Through the Fey Realm'. We are grateful for all of your help and feedback throughout the development of this project made by 3rd year students from Breda University of Applied Sciences. This update includes:

[list]
[*] Added cutscenes to the start and end of the game.
[*] Added several audio improvements (e.g. character dialogue audio, equipment usage audio, credits 
     background music, overall audio level adjustments).
[*] Added cooldown to dialogue response selection.
[*] Removed several punctuation and spelling errors.
[*] Several small improvements in the quests and dialogue based on player feedback.
[*] Fixed bug in tutorial that required the player to delete their local appdata to progress.
[*] Fixed several issues regarding the controls menu.
[*] Additional environmental improvements (e.g. Fishing rod, bakery sign, flags).
[*] [i]Optimized the hidden Frikandellenbroodje. (Shhh, don't tell the others!)[/i]
[/list]

We won't be updating the game anymore as we've reached the end of our development process on this student project. This does mean that there might be some minor bugs left in the game for which you'll have to forgive us. Thank you all so much for your love and support.

And most of all... ENJOY!


- Team Mirrored Cookies

notes.title: Hotfix Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[b]A new build with several hotfixes and other improvements has just been released:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added dialogue for the Lion ending.
[*] Added dialogue for the Unicorn ending.
[*] Improved environment (e.g. new wood textures, rocks, lilypads).
[*] Fixed being able to get multiple pieces of paper from Haigha.
[*] Fixed Alder's dialogue not switching back to normal response.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]
As we're near the end of our school year as students, there will be one final content update coming soon!
Thank you for all your love and support throughout the development of this project.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Alice: Through the Fey Realm - Content Update 1.1
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience! We've been working hard to make adjustments to the game with the help of all your feedback. These changes include: 

[list]
[*] Added Steam achievements.
[*] Added multiple save slots.
[*] Added option to enable/disable V-Sync.
[*] Added graphics presets option.
[*] Added new townsfolk.
[*] Added new NPC behaviour.
[*] Environment revamp.
[*] UI revamp (e.g. inventory icons, dice rolling, and more...)
[*] Fixed level optimization.
[*] Fixed various spelling mistakes & dialogue inconsistencies.
[*] Fixed a few softlocks.
[*] & Other minor changes / bugfixes.
[/list]

With the end of our development cycle as students on this project in sight, we will release a final patch in the upcoming two weeks.

Thank you so much for your support. Have fun!

notes.title: Hotfix Update June 11th
notes.content:
[h3][b]A new build with several hotfixes and other improvements has just been released:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed the softlock when acquiring honey.
[*]Removed the crash when returning to the main menu from the pause menu.
[*]Removed other potential softlocks and crashes.
[*]Removed a bug where the first line of dialogue would sometimes be skipped.
[*]Removed a bug that would set a new walk to location after skipping the final line of dialouge using the left mouse button.
[*]Fixed a bug that would create inconsistency with the full house dice rolling win condition.
[*]Fixed an inventory duplication issue when returning to menu and continuing the game.
[*]Fixed several issues regarding dialogue and missions.
[*]Updated setdressing and setdressing VFX.
[*]Added a new animated cursor.
[*]Updated loading screen.
[*]Added graphics settings.
[*]Other minor fixes.
[/list]
We also added a plugin that let's you opt into having some data of your playsession recorded, which we can use to improve to the game even more in future.

[b]Stay tuned for more updates coming soon![/b]

notes.title: Full Release Update
notes.content:
[b][h3]We have finally hit the day of the full release![/h3][/b]

Just some of the changes and additions are:
[list]
[*]All missions are now playable.
[*]Revamped UI with more final assets.
[*]All new character models.
[*]Improvements in the level and environment.
[*]Expanded dice rolling and equipment systems.
[*]Improved Audio.
[/list]
Since this is a student game and it is still under development, we do expect some issues to persist in this build. We would appreciate you joining our [url=https://discord.gg/YNu6QnUmhY]Community Discord Channel[/url] where you can report bugs and give us feedback. In the following days we will work hard on fixing these issues and will most likely publish several hotfixes this week already, and, with the help of your feedback, we will prepare a final build of this project, planned to be released in a few weeks.

Thank you for playing Alice Through the Fey Realm, enjoy!
